title: Facebook officially rolls out its stand-alone Creator Studio app with AI tools for creators
excerpt: The new app launches with Facebook's AI creator assistant built into it, providing creators with personalized recommendations based on their content style, performance, audience engagement, and goals.
content_html:
Facebook announced on Wednesday that it’s rolling out a stand-alone Creator Studio app, an AI-powered app that gives creators personalized tips to grow their audiences and new tools to engage with their communities. The official iOS rollout comes a few weeks after Facebook began testing the app with select creators.

Facebook’s AI creator assistant is built into the new app to provide creators with personalized recommendations based on their content style, performance, audience engagement, and goals.

Creators often have to sift through charts and dashboards to understand their performance, but with the AI assistant, they can get quick answers to questions like “When should I post?” and “What are people saying in my comments?” Creators can also ask follow-up questions.

By giving creators access to the new Creator Studio app, Meta is looking to keep creators active on Facebook as it competes for their attention against rivals like TikTok and YouTube. The company may also be trying to reduce its reliance on third-party tools like ChatGPT when it comes to content ideas and analyzing performance.

The Creator Studio app includes several new features, including an AI-powered comment tool that surfaces the most important comments and drafts replies in the creator’s own tone. Creators can edit and approve the suggested replies before posting them, according to Facebook.

Additionally, when creators open the app each day, they’ll see a feed of daily priorities, including reviewing their latest post’s performance, tracking progress toward their goals, and flagging comments that need a reply.

Creator Studio is available for all creators on iOS in the United States and Canada.

The new app isn’t Meta’s only recent launch; the company has been on something of a product spree in recent months. The tech giant recently released a stand-alone app for Facebook Groups called Forum that functions similarly to Reddit, an app called Instants that lets users share disappearing photos with Instagram friends, a vibe-coded gaming app called Pocket, and an AI storytelling app called StoryKit that creates AI-generated children’s stories.

content_html_zh:
Facebook 周三宣布，将推出一款独立的 Creator Studio 应用程序，这是一款由人工智能驱动的应用程序，可为创作者提供个性化提示以扩大受众群体，并提供新工具以与社区互动。 在 Facebook 开始与选定的创作者测试该应用程序几周后，iOS 版正式发布。

Facebook 的人工智能创作者助理内置于新应用程序中，可根据创作者的内容风格、表现、受众参与度和目标为其提供个性化推荐。

创作者通常必须筛选图表和仪表板才能了解他们的表现，但有了人工智能助手，他们可以快速获得诸如“我应该什么时候发布？”之类的问题的答案。 以及“人们在我的评论中说了些什么？” 创作者还可以提出后续问题。

通过为创作者提供新的 Creator Studio 应用程序的访问权限，Meta 希望让创作者在 Facebook 上保持活跃，因为 Facebook 正在与 TikTok 和 YouTube 等竞争对手争夺注意力。 在内容创意和分析性能方面，该公司可能还试图减少对 ChatGPT 等第三方工具的依赖。

Creator Studio 应用程序包含多项新功能，包括人工智能驱动的评论工具，可以以创作者自己的语气显示最重要的评论和草稿回复。 据 Facebook 称，创作者可以在发布建议回复之前对其进行编辑和批准。

此外，当创作者每天打开应用程序时，他们会看到每日优先事项的提要，包括查看最新帖子的表现、跟踪目标进度以及标记需要回复的评论。

Creator Studio 可供美国和加拿大 iOS 上的所有创作者使用。

这款新应用程序并不是 Meta 最近推出的唯一一款应用程序。近几个月来，该公司一直在进行产品热潮。 这家科技巨头最近为 Facebook Groups 发布了一款名为 Forum 的独立应用程序，其功能与 Reddit 类似；一款名为 Instants 的应用程序，可让用户与 Instagram 好友分享消失的照片；一款名为 Pocket 的氛围编码游戏应用程序；以及一款名为 StoryKit 的人工智能讲故事应用程序，可创建人工智能生成的儿童故事。
